payload.title: Experiment: show the decision model the title, as the labeler saw it
payload.description:
Pre-registered 2026-10-09 before any run. Motivation (decision-flywheel-c9c5b6e2): the reference labels were generated from title plus excerpt, but the study's decision model sees only the excerpt; with the labeling rubric verbatim, gpt-4.1-mini agrees with the reference on 89.0 percent from the excerpt and 95.5 percent from title plus excerpt (publish recall 79 versus 99 percent).

Design: as decision-flywheel-c9c5b6e2 (400-item corpus, same seed, review everything, empty starting rubric, recorded gate configuration, gpt-4.1-mini optimizer) with --item-fields title,text. Two arms, one run each: Jev 1.13.0 and gpt-4.1-mini. Comparison: the same model without the title (Jev 79.5 percent over cycles 201 to 400; gpt-4.1-mini mean 78, range 75 to 83).

H1: with the title, Jev's evaluator-only accuracy over cycles 201 to 400 is at least 85 percent.
H2: with the title, gpt-4.1-mini's accuracy over cycles 201 to 400 is at least 83 percent (above its no-title range).
H3: the cyclotron's ECE over cycles 301 to 400 stays below the raw model's in both arms.
Reported: accuracy, ECE and mean confidence by window; label differences; promotions; the 0.80 rule and least-confident shares in the last window; cost and time. Fixtures in schema 2; results note in docs/experiments on exp/decision-model-comparison. Budget: about 1.50 USD.
